original_benchmark.notes: CMPhysBench has 520 problems; only 100 have public reference answers (final_answer). 2 of those (ids 55, 74) contain \int/\sum, which upstream SEED always scores 0, 2 more (ids 56, 89) state the answer in the question, so 96 are adaptable. Upstream harness: vLLM single call + first boxed answer + SEED.

harbor_adapter.notes: Parity on all 96 tasks, 3 runs per side. Original side: codex in a fork of CMPhysBench/CMPhysBench scored with upstream SEED.
